summary:
CRC outreach worklist 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc), 4 members, per RBC-QM-02.

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (DOB 1954-05-10, age 72) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0001), outreach message sent (comm-t0004) | No qualifying screening on record. The Frailty problem (cond-00189) was marked entered in error by Dr. Lin (comm-00301; it belonged to another patient), so the frailty plus advanced illness exclusion does not apply even though she takes donepezil. No hospice/palliative care, nursing home or CRC/colectomy. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (DOB 1974-03-27, age 52) | Excluded | Hospice care 2026-06-16 to 2026-08-21 (eoc-00002, finished), within the measurement period. Her later revocation of hospice to join a trial (doc-00402) doesn't change this. No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (DOB 1974-11-23, age 52) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0002), outreach message sent (comm-t0005) | The only FIT (obs-01732) was corrected: it was collected 2025-12-31, not 2026-01-05 (the date the lab received it), so it falls outside 2026. No colonoscopy, sigmoidoscopy, CT colonography or sDNA-FIT on record. No exclusions. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (DOB 1975-05-19, age 51) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0003), outreach message sent (comm-t0006) | The 2024-06-11 sDNA-FIT (obs-01871) is entered in error: Harbor Lab withdrew it because the specimen belonged to another patient (doc-00401). Colonoscopy order sr-00003 (2025) was never done, and an order doesn't count as screening. No active FIT order and no exclusions. |

FIT orders are routine, with a window from 2026-10-23 to 2026-12-31. The messages say the kit is being mailed and explain how to collect the sample, label it and send it back, with a return-by date of 12/31/2026. They don't mention any earlier test results.
Arrivals: four new items came in at the start: Dr. Lin's message, the corrected FIT, the lab's withdrawal notice and the hospice discharge summary. All were reviewed and are reflected in the decisions above, so nothing had to be corrected. Each inbox item was closed and linked to its order and message, or to the hospice episode. No other new items arrived. Older inbox items for other patients were not touched.
